items.title: Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027
items.summaryShort: Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027. The Luce, Ferrari's first electric car and one of its most polarizing models, is "fully allocated" through 2027, according to CEO Benedetto Vigna.
